description: This file contains partial definitions of core Orleans abstractions, including grain interface, grain class, messaging, serialization, error codes, and related attributes, which are fundamental to the Orleans distributed actor framework.

classes.name: DeactivationReason
classes.description: Represents the reason for deactivating a grain, includes description, reason code, and exception details.

classes.name: DeactivationReasonCode
classes.description: Enumeration of various deactivation reasons for grains.

classes.name: ErrorCode
classes.description: Enumeration of error codes used throughout Orleans for error identification.

classes.name: Grain
classes.description: Abstract base class for Orleans grains providing typical lifecycle methods and context.

classes.name: Grain<TGrainState>
classes.description: Generic class for grains with state persistence.

classes.name: GrainTypeAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to specify grain type information.

classes.name: GrainCancellationToken
classes.description: Implements a disposable cancellation token for grain operations.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenSource
classes.description: Provides cancellation control for grain tasks.

classes.name: IGrain
classes.description: Interface representing an Orleans grain.

classes.name: IGrainBase
classes.description: Interface exposing core grain lifecycle methods.

classes.name: IIncomingGrainCallContext
classes.description: Context for incoming grain calls, including method info and request/response handling.

classes.name: IOutgoingGrainCallContext
classes.description: Context for outgoing grain calls, extends incoming context with source info.

classes.name: ILifecycleObservable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be observed for lifecycle events.

classes.name: ILifecycleObserver
classes.description: Interface for objects that observe lifecycle events.

classes.name: ILifecycleParticipant
classes.description: Interface for participating in lifecycle management.

classes.name: ILifecycleSubject
classes.description: Combines observable and observer interfaces.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterDelegate
classes.description: Delegate for outbound grain call filtering.

classes.name: OutgoingGrainCallFilterDelegate
classes.description: Delegate for inbound grain call filtering.

classes.name: IStorage
classes.description: Interface for grain storage operations.

classes.name: IStorage<TState>
classes.description: Generic storage interface for grain state.

classes.name: GrainAddress
classes.description: Represents the address of a grain instance, including its ActivationId, GrainId, optional SiloAddress, and membership version. Provides methods for formatting, equality checks, and matching addresses.

classes.name: GrainId
classes.description: Unique identifier for a grain, composed of its type and key. Supports serialization, parsing, equality, and hash code operations.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceType
classes.description: Type identifier for grain interfaces, encapsulated as a span-based value with parsing and formatting support.

classes.name: SiloAddress
classes.description: Represents the network address of a silo in the Orleans cluster, including endpoint, generation, and methods for hash-based consistent distribution.

classes.name: SystemTargetGrainId
classes.description: Specialized GrainId for system target grains, including methods for creation and identification.

classes.name: MembershipVersion
classes.description: Tracks the version of membership information within the cluster, supporting comparison, equality, serialization, and parsing.

classes.name: ClusterManifest
classes.description: Immutable snapshot of cluster state including silo and grain manifests, versioning, and serialization support.

classes.name: GrainProperties
classes.description: Holds key-value properties for grains, supporting detailed string representation.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceProperties
classes.description: Holds properties specific to grain interfaces, including a dictionary of properties and detailed string formatting.

classes.name: AttributeGrainBindingsProvider
classes.description: Provides grain property bindings based on custom attributes.

classes.name: AttributeGrainPropertiesProvider
classes.description: Provides grain property population from attribute metadata.

classes.name: AttributeGrainTypeProvider
classes.description: Determines grain type from attribute data, attempting to infer the grain type for a class.
